name: Etapp 5: BLT Stáloluoktastugan - BLT Duottarstugan
description: BLT Stáloluoktastugan to BLT Duottarstugan. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Bållávrjåhkå water: Important mid-stage stream/water point. Naturkartan warns to fill here because water is scarce on the stretch ahead toward Duottar.

facilities.name: Bållávrjåhkå suspension bridge
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM bridge feature and Naturkartan/Laponia bridge POI context; route-proximity check places it within a few meters of the stage segment.
facilities.description: Suspension bridge over Bållávrjåhkå, a key mid-stage landmark and water/camping area. Treat currentness as dynamic because it is a seasonal summer bridge.

facilities.name: Bållávrjåhkå water
facilities.coordinateSource: Bridge/stream coordinate; Naturkartan explicitly advises filling water here.
facilities.description: Important mid-stage stream/water point. Naturkartan warns to fill here because water is scarce on the stretch ahead toward Duottar.

facilities.name: BLT Duottar Fjällstuga / Tuottarstugorna
facilities.coordinateSource: Padjelanta.se Tuottar official coordinate; OSM hut way 622411605 center is about 78 m away.
facilities.description: BLT cabin camp at the stage end with 32 beds, one year-round open cabin/room, emergency/help phone, and basic provisions subject to availability.

facilities.name: Duottar provisions / cabin-host sales
facilities.coordinateSource: Hut cluster coordinate; no separate shop coordinate found.
facilities.description: Basic provisions may be sold by hut hosts at Duottar, but stock is limited, may run out, and provision sales are cash-only. Field reports describe availability as variable.

facilities.name: Duottar-side wade / stream crossing 1
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM mapped ford/crossing candidate near Duottar, supported by Naturkartan and Outdoor Wilda reports of two simple wades before Duottar.
facilities.description: One of two reported simple wades shortly before Duottar when walking from Stáloluokta. Difficulty may change with water levels.

facilities.name: Duottar-side wade / stream crossing 2
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM mapped ford/crossing candidate near Duottar, supported by Naturkartan and Outdoor Wilda reports of two simple wades before Duottar.
facilities.description: Second reported simple wade before Duottar. The crossing is near the hut approach and should be treated as condition-dependent.

facilities.name: Gieddejåhkå / Luoppal bridge near Stáloluokta
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM mapped bridge/way near the BD69 Stáloluokta-side route endpoint; supported by STF/Naturkartan route description saying the stage crosses Gieddejåhkå shortly after Stáloluokta.
facilities.description: Bridge/crossing near the Stáloluokta start where the route leaves the settlement area and crosses Gieddejåhkå/Luoppal-side water.

facilities.name: Stáloluokta emergency phone
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM emergency phone node near Stáloluokta hut, supported by BLT/Padjelanta/Naturkartan emergency-phone descriptions.
facilities.description: Emergency/help phone at the Stáloluokta cabin camp. Import as standalone only if emergency-phone POIs are supported; otherwise attach to hut metadata.

facilities.name: Stáloluokta helipad - Kvikkjokk route
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 11051040288 cross-checked with Fiskflyg scheduled Stáloluokta access.
facilities.description: Helipad/access point for the Kvikkjokk-Stáloluokta scheduled helicopter route.

facilities.name: Stáloluokta helipad - Ritsem route
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 11051038021 cross-checked with Fiskflyg scheduled Stáloluokta access.
facilities.description: Helipad/access point for the Ritsem-Stáloluokta scheduled helicopter route.

facilities.name: BLT Stáloluokta Fjällstuga / Stáloluoktastugan
facilities.coordinateSource: Padjelanta.se official coordinate; OSM hut node 1356459001 is about 2 m away.
facilities.description: BLT cabin camp at the stage start with 42 beds, one year-round open room, emergency/help phone, sauna, church hut, summer helicopter access, and arranged/local boat context.
